people.name: Enoch
people.line: A righteous man who walked with God.

people.name: Methuselah
people.line: The oldest person mentioned in the Bible.

translations.web: After Methuselah’s birth, Enoch walked with God for three hundred years, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
translations.bsb: And after he had become the father of Methuselah, Enoch walked with God 300 years and had other sons and daughters.
